comment: Hand-curated index exclusions — the mirror of importance_rules on the exclusion side; edit this list, not the service modules. Value = exclusion SCOPE (comma-joined when several): 'all' = dead everywhere (dropped from stats.sec_importance_ranks by the monthly build, skipped by every service); 'csindex' = csindex.com.cn serves nothing for the code (daily export, PE, intraday) — another downloader owns its daily data; 'csindex_pe' = only the PE (peg) series never returns; 'stream' = intraday ticks never available from any streamer. Evidence: 35-day failure scan of logs/*/csindex_download.log (2026-09-07..2026-10-20) cross-checked against stats.index_identity. [all] 399237, CES100 — zero identity rows, every csindex fetch fails. [csindex] 000170, 000823, 000847, 000849, 000851, 000853, 000854, 000856, 000857, 000858, 000863, 000865, 000867, 000869, 000974 — csindex export/PE/intraday all empty on 20+ of 35 logged days while SSE bulk trend keeps their daily rows current. [csindex] 399001, 399006, 399348, 399346 — SZSE-published, the SZSE downloader owns them (migrated from CSINDEX_SKIP_CODES). [csindex,stream] 399303, 399310, 399311 — cnindex-owned trio (daily via cnindex archive; csindex export empty every logged day; cnindex intraday stream NO DATA every window). [stream] 931265, 931407, 931528, 931688, 931800 — csindex intraday API 'no ticks available' every sweep, daily export current (migrated from CSINDEX_NO_TICK_CODES). [csindex_pe,stream] 931786, H11014 — PE series empty 21-22 of 35 logged days AND intraday never ticks. [csindex_pe] 000011, 000012, 000013, 000022, 000061, 000101, 000116, 000139, 930865, 931018, 931078, 931161, 931552, 931790, 932160, 932200, 950041, 950045, 950109, 950167, 950175, 950243, 950245, H00140, H11077, H11098 — PE series empty 20-25 of 35 logged days, daily export current. DUMMY_* placeholder indices are NOT listed — the is_dummy flag and the runner's DUMMY_ name-prefix skip already handle them.
